_why: round A_2 P3: Apply template has Windows beside Channels and Bands - off is the whole section; on, a length (10 min ... 168 h, or any in hours), an overlap with 50 % recommended (the default), the opt-in that fits the chain to the window, and the trade-off in a plain sentence. The scope sits in the template's detail pane, which paints once /api/discovery/templates answers (minutes on the real-data copy: hence the long wait). Needs no data beyond the canonical templates

round A_2 P3: the window plan is the bridge's (POST /api/discovery/plan with windows; nothing runs): windows per channel x channels, the runs that makes with the null, the estimate and the run-bookkeeping floor, the route, and the shortest window the chain allows with the step that sets it (noise_threshold: step 01's 600 s rolling mean, so 40 min). A session section shorter than 1 h reads as a refusal in words instead of the count; either way the minimum is shown

round A_2 P3: the bound - a window at least 4 x the chain's longest rolling window - refuses the researcher's 10-minute scale for the 600 s detrend family, naming step 01 and saying how to go on (40 min or longer, or fit the chain: a different chain). The researcher's decision on this is in RQ4b

round A_2 P3: with 'fit the chain's internal windows to this window length' ticked, the 10-minute scale plans: the 600 s rolling mean becomes 150 s, written in the recipe - its own algorithm version and its own row on the Map - and the plan says what changed

round A_2 P3: a windowed application is ONE Discovery run, named by its scale ('noise_threshold · 1 h windows · 50 %'), its runs the stitched windows (one per channel), so found is the stitched count. Populated once a template has been applied with windows on the sandbox and has finished; the empty arm is the runs list

round A_2 P3: the window scope joins the Map's row key, so a windowed application is its own row beside the whole-span run ('... · 1 h windows · 50 %'), each scale its own version of the algorithm; its cells count the stitched set, so overlapping windows are not counted twice. Populated once a windowed run has finished in the sandbox; the empty arm is the map card

round A_2 P3 fix round (m6): the window card plans with the band scope. Turning the bands on ticks the named bands (Settings > Analysis defaults; Q43's seed starts with 0.001-0.01 Hz, whose bandpass reads a 1,000 s period, so it needs 66.7 min windows): at 1-hour windows the card is refused naming that band and its minimum - before the fix it said runnable and the apply refused it. A sandbox whose band list has no band that slow would read the count instead
